title: MineKeK modpack
description: MineKeK Modpack — a lightweight Fabric modpack for maximum FPS and vanilla-style visuals.
body:
**MineKeK Modpack** — a lightweight client-side Fabric modpack for Minecraft, created for maximum FPS, convenience, and pleasant vanilla-style graphics. The modpack is designed for playing on the **MineKeK server**.

The modpack does not change gameplay and does not add items or blocks — it only improves performance, the interface, and small visual details.

# 🚀 Performance

- **Sodium**, **Lithium**, **FerriteCore**, **EntityCulling**, **ImmediatelyFast**, and **Dynamic FPS** provide smooth and stable gameplay without lag.

# 🌈 Graphics

- **Iris**, **Dynamic Lights**, **improved animations**, **3D skins**, and **beautiful particles** — vanilla, but better.

# 🧭 Convenience

- **MiniHUD**, **BetterF3**, **AppleSkin**, **ShulkerBoxTooltip**, an **improved chat** and **tab list** — everything you need at your fingertips.

# 🧱 Building & Recording

- **Litematica**, **Freecam**, **ReplayMod**, and **schematic previews** — perfect for building and video creation.

# 💬 Multiplayer

- **PlasmoVoice**, **EmoteCraft**, and **extended chat history**.

# 🗺 Navigation

- **Xaero’s World Map** and a convenient zoom feature.
